instruction:
Extract one current IEP service commitment from the supplied text. Return only one flat JSON object with exactly these fields: serviceName, sessionsPerPeriod, minutesPerSession, sourceQuote, needsReview.
serviceName is a string or null. Normalize clearly named speech/speech-language therapy, including an explicitly defined SLP abbreviation, to "Speech-Language Therapy". Determine each field independently and keep explicitly supported fields even if another field is unknown. If more than one service is present with no selected target, use null for the service and both numeric fields; do not choose a target or merge service allocations.
sourceQuote must be a nonempty, verbatim, contiguous substring of the supplied text. Include enough text to support the extracted values and any uncertainty, conflict, negation, or scope ambiguity. Do not paraphrase, splice quotations, or quote the task instructions.
needsReview is true whenever any field is unknown or null, evidence conflicts, the commitment is negated or historical only, a frequency is not representable as an integer weekly commitment, or the service scope is unclear. Otherwise it is false. Do not infer student identity, compare with a separate student fixture, or make legal, clinical, or service-compliance conclusions.
